title: sshdump: add capability to use doas on remote host
description:
Change sshdump --remote-sudo into --remote-priv to allow for selection
of remote capture privilege elevation method: none, sudo or doas.
Add --remote-priv-user as optional parameter for this.
Allow --remote-sudo for backward compatibility with scripts, but do
not expose as supported interface.
Handle preference translation from --remote-sudo to remote-priv.
Update manual page with these and other missing parameters.

Closes #18845

notes.body:
I think it the help message would be more understandable if it were phrased as it appears in sshdump.c:

`The command to use as proxy for the SSH connection`

That's a better explanation for the ProxyCommand ssh option

Hi Gilbert, nice to hear from you again.

I'll change the wording to that as it appears in sshdump.c.

Thanks! Yes, I'm happy to work with you and the team again!
